meta.name: self-improvement
meta.description: Captures learnings, errors, and corrections to enable continuous improvement. Use when: (1) A command or operation fails unexpectedly, (2) User corrects Claude ('No, that's wrong...', 'Actually...'), (3) User requests a capability that doesn't exist, (4) An external API or tool fails, (5) Claude realizes its knowledge is outdated or incorrect, (6) A better approach is discovered for a recurring task. Also review learnings before major tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 记录经验教训,持续改进工作方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望每次操作后自动积累经验,越用越聪明
copy.tagline_en: Capture learnings and errors to continuously improve
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically accumulate experience and get smarter with each use

howto.what: Claude 会自动记录错误、用户纠正、知识过时等信息到 .learnings/ 文件夹的日志文件中，并在后续任务中参考这些记录来改进表现。
howto.when: 当命令执行失败、用户纠正 Claude、请求不存在功能、外部工具出错、Claude 发现知识过时或发现更好的做法时触发。

say.text: 我刚刚说错了，应该是用 pnpm 而不是 npm。
say.note: Claude 会记录这个纠正到 LEARNINGS.md。

say.text: 这个 API 调用失败了，帮我查一下原因。
say.note: Claude 会记录错误到 ERRORS.md。

say.text: 你能添加一个导出 CSV 的功能吗？

howto.what_en: Claude automatically logs errors, corrections, outdated knowledge, etc. to .learnings/ files and references them in future tasks to improve performance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a command fails, user corrects Claude, a missing feature is requested, an external tool errors, Claude finds outdated knowledge, or a better approach is discovered.

say_en.text: I was wrong, it should be pnpm not npm.
say_en.note: Claude logs this correction to LEARNINGS.md.

say_en.text: This API call failed, can you investigate?
say_en.note: Claude logs the error to ERRORS.md.

say_en.text: Can you add a CSV export feature?
say_en.note: Claude logs the feature request to FEATURE_REQUESTS.md.
